comparison_limits: Exact p-variables have a uniform null law and are pivotal, whereas exact e-variables have expectation one. Pointwise expectation improvement, positive expected log and uniform positive infimum are different requirements.

Preserve the theorem-specific JA exceptions, including the Euclidean product result without JA and later clauses dispensing with it. AC is P_i absolutely continuous with respect to Q, not its reverse; common domination in Theorem 6.7 is different, and its pivotal strengthening remains a conjecture.

A maximum dominating every feasible measure differs from a maximal element. Theorem 5.3's N branch yields a maximal limit, and only an existing maximum gives convergence to that maximum; finite SHINE outputs need not be maximal.

The source's closed complement overlaps the half-space boundary. N makes the split measure unique, not necessarily its half-space; strictly positive density is a separate uniqueness hypothesis. Atomic selections, zero-mass children and null-state transitions lack supplied conventions.

Keep vector barycenters versus scalar first coordinates and the scalar SHINE martingale distinct. The almost-sure convergence wording for measures relies on the preceding coupling interpretation. Theorem 5.5's contextual use of N is not an explicit repeated premise.

The positive and inverse moment requirements may hold on different coordinate indices. The e-variable density ratio and SHINE coordinate are reciprocals, with minus log in EP; AC alone does not settle zero-density or infinite-objective conventions.

The infinite-family clause and Remark 6.3 do not justify uniform positive TV separation merely from pointwise improvement or disjoint unclosed convex hulls. Preserve the missing domination/closure/uniformity issues instead of certifying or repairing the theorem.

Theorem 6.7's nested total-variation closures must remain nested; only its tight-Q clause gives the simpler individually closed-set condition. Total variation, tightness, martingales and Radon-Nikodym theory remain ambient prerequisites.
Pure product null laws P_i^k are not all mixed products or powers of mixtures. Keep sample-space dimension restrictions separate from null-family size. Retain the pinned December 2024 arXiv v4.
